subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Partha Pratim Majumder is a famous mime artist. He was born in Pabna. He spent most of his early years in his ancestral home. It was one of the biggest houses, situated in a small village known as Kalachandpara. There were festivals and various types of cultural shows throughout the year. His father was a photographer. He was also an art lover. He inspired Majumder to appreciate different forms of art. Majumder first came across Jogesh Dutta in Kolkata. He was much impressed by Jogesh Dutta's performance. He learnt lessons from Dutta on mime in Jogesh Dutta's mine academy in Kolkata from 1966 to 1972.
